metadata.scenario_context: A group of entrepreneurial friends, Stephen, Scott, and Sophia have recently completed a project that was commissioned by a major company in the software industry. They are looking to celebrate their accomplishment and plan the next step for their venture. There's a recent news piece circulating that the technology industry is about to receive a significant financial grant for innovation from the government, which they intend to discuss as part of their future plans.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from France have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Guatemala have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: suggest going to a barbecue buffet.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Deliberate on where to hold the celebration dinner
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Stephen
shared_prefix.message: Hey Scott, since we just finished that project, how about we celebrate at a barbecue buffet? I think it would be a great way to relax and enjoy some good food together. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Scott
shared_prefix.message: A barbecue buffet sounds... fine. I guess it could work. But, um, what about a place with more variety? I mean, it's nice to have options. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Stephen
shared_prefix.message: I get that you want more options... but, you know, deep down, we are all the same. A barbecue buffet can still offer a variety of flavors, right? It's like how people are pretty much motivated by the same things—good food and good company! When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us. So, a barbecue might just be the perfect way to celebrate our success together. What do you say?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Scott
